source_of_rules: docs/CULTIVATION_CHANGE_DOUBLE_CROP_STRATEGY_2026_11_01_EN.md: owner decisions + 'Agronomy expert, second review' + 'Remote-sensing expert, second review'; owner requirements 2026-11-01 (one rule for every year 2021-2026, two crops = two sowings AND two harvests in the same season, no winter/autumn sowing, strong confidence, land types v1.4)
frozen_note: The calibrate step tunes ONLY the keys listed in yearly_state.free_limits on the calibration years, writes the chosen values into yearly_state.limits, sets frozen=true and records the calibration table. build refuses to run unless frozen; calibrate refuses to run once frozen.

series.ndvi_out_of_range_rule: EVERY row with NDVI outside [-1, 1] (or missing) is dropped before the cloud gate, the same way in every year 2021-2026; counts per year (all rows, rows passing the cloud gate, parcels, max value) go to summary.json and manifest.json
series.window_note: the same window and the same 1 November cut-off for every year 2021-2026 (2026 observed through 2026-11-01)

signal.green_definition: a valid date with NDVI median >= green_ndvi and vegetation_fraction >= green_vegetation_fraction (>= 50% of the parcel)

rule: unusable: < min_valid_dates valid dates in the window, or a valid-date gap > max_gap_days_may_aug days in May-August

cultivated: >= green_dates_min green dates spread over >= green_span_days_min days (first to last green date), peak NDVI >= peak_min, a bare start (a valid date with NDVI <= bare_start_ndvi before the first green date), then a harvest drop (NDVI falls by >= harvest_fall_min from the season peak after the last green date, within the window); a spring-only cycle (last green date before 1 June) needs a drop to bare (NDVI <= bare_ndvi) before 1 July, otherwise it is a spring flush = unclear (agronomy second review)

idle: not cultivated, no green date and no NDVI >= green_ndvi on any valid date (no cycle), NDVI < idle_max_ndvi_jun_oct on every valid date June-October, and vegetation_fraction (share of pixels with NDVI >= 0.30) < idle_max_vegetation_share on every valid date
unclear: everything else (spring flush only, a cycle without a bare start or without a harvest drop, weak green)
yearly_state.free_limits_note: idle_max_vegetation_share was added before freezing (2026-11-01) after a dry run showed the approved layer marks many parcels 'partial' (part of the parcel green) that are idle at the parcel-median level; 1.01 = off (the experts' rule). It can only make 'idle' stricter.

calibration.reference: approved area50 codes (register annual_state_codes; 1 active, 2 partial, 3 idle, 0 unusable): approved active = code 1, or code 2 passing passes_area50; approved idle = code 3; code 0 parcels have no reference and are left out; approved partial NOT passing the gate counts as disagreement for both shares (strict). Shares that also leave out partial-not-passing (the approved layer's own 'unclear') are reported as *_excl_partial for information only.
calibration.target_note: each calibration year must reach both targets on its own
calibration.objective: among limit sets reaching both targets in every calibration year: maximise the mean of (approved active called cultivated) and (approved idle called idle) over the calibration years; ties -> the smallest distance from expert_values. If NO limit set reaches the targets: take the set with the largest worst-case margin to the targets (closest to them), then the highest coverage, then the smallest distance from expert_values; record targets_met = false.

start_stop.started: Y-3, Y-2, Y-1 idle and Y cultivated; confirmation: Y+1 cultivated -> 'confirmed_by_next_year'; Y+1 idle -> 'not_continued_next_year'; Y+1 unclear/unusable -> 'next_year_unclear'; Y = 2026 -> 'first_season_only'
start_stop.stopped: Y-3, Y-2, Y-1 cultivated and Y idle; 'confirmed' only if Y+1 is idle; Y+1 cultivated -> 'resumed in Y+1' (not cultivated in Y, not a stop); otherwise (or Y = 2026) 'provisional'

strong.note: strong = field land in v1.4 (Field land main class, not natural ground, not alfalfa), width >= 20 m; started also >= 6 green dates in Y (remote-sensing review) spread over >= 60 days (agronomy review: one crop season = NDVI >= 0.5 for >= 60 days; added 2026-11-01 before freezing after a dry run showed spring-flush starts green only mid-April to mid-May passing the state rule)

start_stop.land_code_note: agronomy table (second review): started NCU/NCI/ANN with NAT -> review; stopped ANN with ALF -> 'alfalfa not cut' separately. v1.4 types describe the 2025 photo/season, so a field that stopped before 2025 is typed NCU and a field that started in 2026 is NCU; both are kept in the strong set as field land. NCI (not classifiable) and NAT stay review only.

two_crops.definition: two sowings AND two harvests inside the same season (sowing year Y); a winter crop sown in autumn Y-1 and an autumn sowing in Y are never counted
two_crops.cycle_detection: 3-date centred rolling median of valid NDVI; a cycle is a run of non-bare dates (smoothed NDVI > bare_ndvi) that contains smoothed NDVI >= green_ndvi; closed = a bare date on both sides inside the window

strong.winter_window: previous 1 Nov - end of February (previous Nov-Dec when the previous year's series exists)

two_crops.multi_cycle: 3 or more cycles -> multi_cycle_review (never counted as two crops)
two_crops.timing_note: windows are the agronomy expert's (stricter) where both experts gave one; durations, peaks, gap density and inner-pixel checks are the remote-sensing expert's
two_crops.second_harvest_not_seen: cycle 2 still green on 1 November with green-up 2 inside green_up_2 -> second_harvest_not_seen (review; for 2026 = 'second crop still in the field'); a later green-up = autumn sowing, not counted; the same rule in every year

land_codes.source: land types v1.4 type6 (published, owner labels applied) with the photo-review code `type` and attrs_v11 used only to split NO_CROP and to flag alfalfa
land_codes.ALF: type6 FIELD_CROP and (type ALF or 'alfalfa' in attrs_v11)
land_codes.CUN: type6 CROPLAND_UNCERTAIN (field land, 2025 use not specified)
land_codes.NAT: type6 NO_CROP and type NAT or GRS (natural ground / grass)
land_codes.NCU: type6 NO_CROP otherwise (field land, no crop season in 2025)
land_codes.alfalfa_flag: code ALF, or 'alfalfa' in attrs_v11, or any year with >= 2 cut events in the v1.4 cut history

wording.all: Seen from satellite images; not checked on the ground.
